Google Play services Nearby Connections (com.google.android.gms:play-services-nearby)

Used for: playing one game on several phones (Share this game / Join a game, beta), phone to
phone over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. Only in the Play build; the build without Play services
(-Pscan7.foss=true) does not contain it.

(https://developers.google.com/terms) and the Android Software Development Kit License
(https://developer.android.com/studio/terms).
